description: AdRoll legacy roundtrip.js browser events on the exact /pixel/advertiser/pixel route. Checks path identities, populated numeric conversion values, page URL and producer flags. Legacy USC amounts and escaped Unicode custom data remain valid. Modern advertiser-specific v2 bundles and other collectors are outside this source profile.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: The legacy SDK supplies this path identity without a published fixed length.

params.name: pixel_id
params.description: The legacy SDK supplies this path identity without a published fixed length.

params.name: conv_value
params.description: The SDK emits a numeric conversion amount when configured. Dollar convenience values are converted to integer cents.

params.name: adroll_currency
params.description: The SDK passes the configured currency or emits legacy USC for its dollar convenience input. USC remains accepted.

params.name: arrfrr
params.description: The SDK sends the current absolute page URL after redacting selected sensitive query values.

params.name: pv
params.description: The producer generates a numeric page-view value, which can be fractional.

params.name: no-cookies
params.description: The producer uses 1 when cookies are unavailable.

params.name: adroll_external_data
params.description: Custom data uses legacy JavaScript escape, including percent-u Unicode and Latin-1 bytes. It remains opaque rather than being misread as UTF-8 form data.

params.name: adroll_version
params.description: The source identifies its legacy runtime version.

params.name: cookie
params.description: An empty cookie string is a valid initial request.

params.name: method
params.description: The pinned producer uses these transport methods.
